reply.text:
I can't give you a diet or a calorie number in chat, but I can help with the hunger side. Most of what keeps people full is general: protein at every meal, plenty of vegetables and fruit, whole foods over liquid calories, water through the day, and sleep. Short sleep makes hunger noticeably louder. Don't cut so hard that every day is a fight, because that usually ends in a binge and not in abs.

The app can work out targets from your own height, weight and activity, with safe floors, so you aren't guessing at a number. Want me to set that up for a cut? Tell me a pace if you have one in mind, like a pound a week, and I'll put the card together for you to check.
